Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Darkling Trickery:

Card Text:
[obt] Press, only usable to end combat.
[myt] Maneuver or press.
[MYT] Only usable when the opposing minion attempts to strike
with a weapon that does ranged damage. The damage from that
weapon is reduced to zero. The opposing minion takes 1 additional
damage during strike resolution.

Question 1: (All refer to superior MYT)
Minion A strikes at long with .44
Minion B responds with Darkling Trickery, and some long range strike
Minion A Blurs and strikes twice more with gun

Does the Darkling Trickery affect additional strikes (guessing no)

Question 2 (on assumption of "no" to question 1)
Can minion B play darkling trickery again each strike? (guessing yes)

Question 3 (unrelated to Darkling Trickery)
There is no restriction against using multiple Psyche! at superior in
successive combats is there?

Thanks,
-JTP

>
> Card Text:

> [myt] Maneuver or press.
> [MYT] Only usable when the opposing minion attempts to strike
> with a weapon that does ranged damage. The damage from that

>
> Question 1: (All refer to superior MYT)
> Minion A strikes at long with .44
> Minion B responds with Darkling Trickery, and some long range strike
> Minion A Blurs and strikes twice more with gun
>
> Does the Darkling Trickery affect additional strikes (guessing no)

No. DT doesn't state that its effect is up for this round.

> > Question 2 (on assumption of "no" to question 1)
> Can minion B play darkling trickery again each strike? (guessing yes)

Yes.

I have a question regarding to this: can i play several Darkling Trickery
in response of a single gun R strike?

> Question 3 (unrelated to Darkling Trickery)
> There is no restriction against using multiple Psyche! at superior in
> successive combats is there?

No. You can have something like this:
Minion A plays S:CE.
Minion B punches in the air.
Combat Ends. Minion B plays Psyche!.
Minion A plays S:CE again.
Minion B punches in the air again.
Combat Ends. Minion B plays Psyche!.
Minion A makes a hand strike.
Minion B plays Undead Strength, Blur, US, US.

.- Luis Duarte
